decisions.reason: Although it serves the maritime segment, submarine interior lighting is relatively far from the firm's core lighting business, so even with in-house R&D it offers weaker learning spillovers and is a candidate to exit in favor of core LED lines.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's established industrial lighting capabilities, and the 2019 LED replacement-kit extension shows the firm can assimilate feedback and keep improving the line.
The designer task light is close to the firm's existing know-how and its relaunch as a popular product suggests enough market acceptance for a large expanding firm to retain it.

A pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core professional building-lighting offer, where its engineering, testing and R&D resources make continued refinement and commercialization relatively low risk.

The premium pendant luminaire line is close to the established offer and, as a multi-model product family, is well suited to the firm's absorptive capacity and strategic direction toward innovative LED solutions.
